episodes.title: Bundle of Love
episodes.summary: A lavish party at the Caterham estate results in sore heads the next day — and one guest not waking up at all. Grief pushes Bundle to search for answers.

episodes.title: Battle Commences
episodes.summary: Bundle's desperate search for the killer takes her from London's seedy underbelly to a country house gathering which could change the course of history.

episodes.title: The Finger Points
episodes.summary: After the police catch an intruder and Battle finds two bullets, Bundle makes a shocking discovery. Can she finally uncover the mastermind behind it all?
